basis: Codex performed-action record with retained passive command/file outputs; not independent external-process audit
passive_operations: Docker ps/inspect/top and bounded existing logs only; no exec/follow
Read-only existing proc roots/exe backing files/maps/selected env/argv/configs/socket tables/routes/fd symlinks/device lstat
Read current cgroups/pressure/namespaces and existing package/version/source/workflow/log-directory metadata
Read immutable history, replay offline and compare hashes/Git; write new RRM package and authorized PROJECT_STATUS only
credentials_excluded: No token/secret environment values or unrestricted argv retained
limitation: Lifecycle metadata unchanged during collection; cannot prove absence of transient unrelated external actions or safe physical containment.
